hook: You can predict the LoRA size a dataset needs.
hookText: You can predict the LoRA size a dataset needs

beats.say: The authors built a predictive theory of how much a LoRA adapter can hold as a function of its rank.
Given a fine-tuning dataset, the theory predicts the size required to fit it, landing within zero point four percent of the exact capacity at five hundred twelve by one thousand twenty-four.
Smaller adapters are lighter to load, faster to generate text from, and easier to store, and rank one can already hold a lot.
